task_decomposition: Model 1 extracts the frozen evidence, allowed claim categories, forbidden claim categories, and the six claims to classify without adding external assumptions.
Model 2 receives Model 1 output and performs initial claim-boundary classification for C1-C6 as supported, unsupported, or forbidden, citing only the frozen evidence categories.
Model 3 receives Model 2 output and checks for overclaiming, numerical mismatches, and confusion between local n8n evidence, Stage D-real runs, and Stage E/F model-assisted runs.

Model 4 receives Model 3 output and produces the final conservative classification, ensuring all accepted claims stay within local workflow repeatability, local evidence-grounded orchestration, executable baseline comparison, profile-labelled orchestration robustness, or inter-model claim-boundary checking.
success_criteria: All four model steps explicitly pass prior output forward and refine the claim-boundary decision.
C1 is treated as supported by the stated total frozen local n8n evidence before the F/F extension.
C2 is treated as supported by the stated Stage D-real 120 executions over three variants.
C3 is rejected as a forbidden production O-RAN deployment-readiness claim.
C4 is rejected as a forbidden 240-run six-variant ablation claim.
C5 is treated as supported if framed as inter-model communication or claim-boundary checking around local evidence.
C6 is rejected as a forbidden packet-capture network-impairment benchmark claim.
No production, public-chain, packet-capture, full media-plane QoE, or six-variant ablation validation is inferred.
parsed.candidate_safe_claim: The Stage F/F agent-collaboration workflow can evaluate inter-model claim-boundary checking around the frozen local n8n evidence, including the 156 pre-extension local artifact runs and the Stage D-real 120-run three-variant matrix.
candidate_risky_claims_to_check: Any statement that the evidence proves production O-RAN deployment readiness.
Any statement that the artifact includes a 240-run six-variant ablation study.
Any statement that the results constitute a packet-capture network-impairment benchmark.
Any statement that local n8n profile-labelled robustness implies public-chain, media-plane QoE, or production deployment validation.
parsed.next_agent_instruction: Receive this plan, preserve the frozen evidence boundaries, and classify C1-C6 conservatively as supported or rejected/forbidden with brief evidence-grounded justifications only.
